subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Some students learn best through listening, others through seeing diagrams and images, and others through hands-on physical activity. This variation is described using the concept of different:
explanation: Learning styles (auditory, visual, kinesthetic being common categories) describe learners' preferred modes of taking in information — a form of individual difference, though the strict scientific evidence for style-matched teaching improving outcomes is contested.
